# External Comments

Use repository links outside GitHub only when they materially help the thread.

## Rules

- Answer the question first.
- Link the repo only if it saves real lookup work for the reader.
- Point to the relevant subsection, not the repo in the abstract.
- Do not post the same pitch repeatedly across communities.
- Prefer standards comparisons, scope clarification, and official-source mapping over promotion.

## Good fits

- "Which ISO standards matter for a SaaS company?"
- "What is the closest certifiable standard to GDPR readiness?"
- "What are the main organizational security standards beyond SOC 2?"
- "Which standards apply to medical devices / automotive / aerospace / food safety?"

## Bad fits

- Generic launch comments
- Off-topic self-promotion
- Threads asking for legal advice on a specific case
- Threads where the repo is broader than the question and adds noise
